newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAISIO JUMPS TO NEW HIGH ON FOREIGN DEMAND.
newsitem.headline: RAISIO JUMPS TO NEW HIGH ON FOREIGN DEMAND.

text.p: Finnish food, animal feed and chemicals group Raision Tehtaat Oy rose sharply to a new life-high in fair trade on Monday as foreign demand continued to boost the share, brokers said.
At 1425/1225 GMT, Raisio traded at a new life-high of 340.00 markka, up 23.00 markka or more than seven percent, after hitting 341.00. Trade was a lively 10 million markka.
The previous 339.90 record was set on September 2 last year.
Foreign demand was fuelled by a positive article in the International Herald Tribune on Raisio's Benecol margarine last Thursday, one broker said.
